results.note: Commentaria: Only partial translations of selected passages exist in de Rijk (1988-1989) scholarly citations, not a complete translation. Some passages translated in secondary literature.
De sex principiis: Despite extensive searches, no English translation of this Aristotelian commentary work found. Exists primarily in Latin editions.
Epistola ad Matthaeum: Very short work (658 words). No dedicated search yielded results; insufficient evidence to classify definitively.
Tractatus contra Judaeos: Medieval dialogue work. No English translation found despite searches. Only Latin Patrologia Latina edition (PL CCIX, col. 423-458).
Alexandreis: Verse translation by David Townsend published by University of Pennsylvania Press (1996); earlier prose translation by R. Telfryn Pritchard (PIMS, 1986). Modern commercial editions.
Liber de Trinitate: Medieval theological dialogue. No English translation found in searches. Exists only in Latin Patrologia Latina edition.
De oratione jejunio et eleemosyna: 13-book Cistercian treatise on prayer, fasting, and almsgiving. No English translation found despite searches.
Historia captae a Latinis Constantinopoleos: Fourth Crusade chronicle by Gunther of Pairis. Primary source on 1204 conquest of Constantinople. No English translation found in searches.
Ligurinus: Epic poem on Frederick Barbarossa. No English translation located despite searches. Known from various Latin editions only.
Appendix ad epistolas: Some select letters (77, 80) translated by John Collorafi on Orthodox Christian Theology blog, but no systematic complete English translation identified.
Epistolae et decreta: Large collection of papal letters on Acacian Schism and church reunion. Partial translations exist but no complete, published English translation confirmed.
Opusculum I: Very short work (444 words). No specific search results. Insufficient evidence.
Decreta: Early 5th-century papal decrees. Partial translations of individual decretals exist, but no complete English translation of the Decreta found.
Epistolae et decreta: Large collection of papal letters and decrees. While individual letters cited in scholarship, no complete English translation located.
Epistolae: Selected letters. Individual examples may appear in ecclesiastical history works, but no dedicated English translation found.
Conflictus de Deo Trino et Uno: Theological dialogue on Trinity. Despite searches, no English translation of this 5th-century work found.
Commentarii in Psalmos: Massive (104,626 words) allegorical commentary on Psalms. Critical edition CCSL 25 (1990) exists, but no English translation located.
Annales (attributed to Hincmarus Rhemensis?): 9th-century historical annals. No English translation found despite searches for both Hincmar and the work title.
Responsio ad quorumdam quaestiones: Very short work (1,054 words), attributed to Hincmarus Rhemensis or another author. No search results located.
De medicina animae: Spiritual/allegorical treatise on the soul's medicine. No English translation found despite searches of this Hugo de Folieto work.
De bestiis et aliis rebus: Compilation including bestiary material. Search results show Latin manuscripts and one French translation, but no English translation.

Commentarium in VII psalmos poenitentiales: Large (64,968 words) commentary on penitential psalms, attributed to Innocent III. Catalan translation exists (1382-1409), but no English translation found.
Regula ordinis S. Spiritus de Saxia: Rule for the Holy Spirit hospital order in Rome. Based on Rule of Augustine. No English translation located in searches.
Sermones S. Leoni Magno attributi: Sermons attributed to Leo I. The authentic Leo I sermons have English translation in Fathers of the Church series, vol. 93 (1995); this covers the corpus.
Epistola ad Demetriadem: Letter to a dedicated virgin on humility, attributed to Leo I (5th cent). Only available in Latin Wikisource edition; no English translation found.
Concordatum Wormatiense: 1122 Investiture Compromise. English translation available in Bolton & Duggan's 'Adrian IV' (2003) and other modern ecclesiastical history works.
Epistolae et privilegia: Papal letters and privileges of Calixtus II. Selections translated in Bolton & Duggan (2003) and other modern scholarly editions covering 12th-century papacy.
Vita Adriani IV: Biography of Pope Adrian IV by Cardinal Boso. Referenced in modern scholarship but no dedicated English translation located.
Vita Alexandri III: Biography of Pope Alexander III by Cardinal Boso. No English translation found despite searches. Only Latin Documenta Catholica Omnia edition located.
Codex canonum ecclesiae universae: Collection of early church canons. English translation by William Lambarde (1868) available in parallel columns with Greek and Latin via Internet Archive (free).
Concilia: Church councils. Fully translated in NPNF Series 2, Vol. 14 'The Seven Ecumenical Councils' (ed. Henry Percival, 1895) available free at CCEL (ccel.org) and Tertullian.org.
Carmen: Short poetic work (358 words) by Gaudentius of Brescia. Searches did not yield specific results; may be included in Boehrer dissertation but no confirmation.
Sermones: 21 authentic tractates/sermons. English translation by Stephen L. Boehrer, 'Gaudentius of Brescia: Sermons and Letters' (Catholic University of America PhD dissertation, 1965).
Decreta: Small collection (214 words). Includes 'Ad abolendam' (1184), with English translation available in ecclesiastical history sources and canons collections.
Epistolae et privilegia: Large collection (103,856 words) of papal letters. Some selections translated in ecclesiastical history works, but completeness unclear.
Epistolae: Papal letters of Pope Martin I (7th cent). Some documents translated through Anastasius Bibliothecarius's 9th-century translations, but systematic English translation status unclear.
Privilegia: Small collection of privileges (2,029 words). No specific translation search results; insufficient evidence.
Vita S. Dunstani: Life of Saint Dunstan by Osbernus of Canterbury. William of Malmesbury's Vita has English translation, but Osbernus version has no English translation located.
Vita S. Elphegi: Life of Saint Elphegi by Osbernus. Medieval Latin hagiography, published in Acta Sanctorum but no English translation found despite searches.
Liber sententiarum: Theological sentences on Eucharist by Stephen of Muret. No English translation found. Not to be confused with Peter Lombard's more famous Sentences.
Regula: Monastic rule for Grandmontine order by Stephen of Muret (founder). No English translation located in searches despite rule's ecclesiastical significance.
Epistolae et decreta: Large collection (49,190 words) of papal documents on Three Chapters controversy. Partial translations in scholarly works, but complete English edition unclear.
Pro damnatione trium capitulorum: Vigilius's defense of Three Chapters condemnation. No specific English translation located despite historical significance.
Sermones: Very large sermon collection (113,447 words) by Absalon of Springiersbach (Cistercian abbot). Latin editions only; no English translation found in searches.
Epistolae et privilegia: Large collection (89,555 words) of Pope Adrian IV's letters and privileges. Selections translated in Bolton & Duggan's 'Adrian IV the English Pope' (2003).
